messages:
Tori: Quick logistics q for the offsitedo we know if the conference is running a shuttle from the airport or is everyone grabbing rideshare?
Ethan: Conference site lists a shuttle at 9am and 11am only. If you land between those windows youre golden.
Maya: I land at 8:30am. Thinking of taking the 9am shuttle but worried about customs. Anyone else arriving early?
Luis: Im arriving 7:50am. Planning for rideshare just in case. ETA should be ~40m depending on traffic.
Tori: Good call on buffer. ops-bot any reminder about shared ride expensing?
ops-bot: Reminder: Rideshares to/from airport are reimbursable up to $70. If you share a ride, list co-passengers on the expense. See #finance for details. :robot_face:
Ethan: Also PSA: if your luggage goes missing, file a claim at the airline desk immediately and take photos of the baggage tag. That sped up my replacement last time.
Maya: Ugh that happened to me. Hotel was able to loan a charger and some basics overnight. Pro tip: pack a tiny emergency kit in your carry-on (toothbrush, t-shirt, phone cable).
Luis: Question: rental car vs rideshare for site visits the next day? Were 30 mins from venue but might need client visits.
Tori: If its just a few of us, shared rides are cheaper. But if you need flexible stops and multiple meetings, rental wins. Also rental gives trunk space for swag.
Ethan: Poll: rental / rideshare / mix-and-match (rent for half-days) react with emoji
Maya: ":car:" for rental
Luis: ":oncoming_taxi:" for rideshare
Tori: ":arrows_counterclockwise:" for mix-and-match
Ethan: One last thing  if anyone wants to try seat upgrades for the flight, the airline often posts last-minute upgrade deals 48h before. Might be worth watching.
Maya: Thanks all. Ill aim for the 9am shuttle but DM if the plane gets delayed.
Luis: I'll coordinate a shared rideshare group if shuttle misses us. Drop arrival ETA here.
Tori: @here also bring a spare phone charger to the meetup table  someone always forgets theirs and it becomes a crisis. :sweat_smile:
